scope: Sony A6000 FW 3.21; static local analysis only; no camera interaction, firmware execution or binary modification.
method: static comparison with S19-04 Camera contract and prior DMM extent extraction

findings.finding: Factory case 0x6013 allocates 0xd4 bytes and invokes constructor 0x1761a8.
Constructor initializes output descriptor fields and stores a 0x2001/0x1003 PlayData message at +0xd0.
Candidate BeginExecCommand for SequencePinDeliverExecWriteStillCmd; exact virtual-slot name remains unresolved.
Requires non-null holder +0x14, interface +0x8 and nonzero virtual selector 12, then selector 3 and infrastructure connection; no unitType comparison occurs in this method.
Local DataflowInfra endpoints are connected through infraConnectPin; no Camera object or Camera descriptor is identified.
PbCap path allocates own DMM raster/SDS outputs, prepares descriptors and submits ObjMsg(0x3900,0x3000).
SDF command endpoint is derived from holder CID and command conversion; input YC source remains undecoded.
Only result 0x111 publishes output PlayData with raster/SDS, geometry, colorimetry and Y-range.
Completion cleanup disconnects DataflowInfra and closes normal-output DMM units; this does not establish Camera source ownership.

findings.method: llvm-objdump plus prior DMM extent extraction
findings.finding: Normal outputs are raster 0x50b3f/0xed/0x3fc000 and SDS 0xe0b00/0xe4/0x800; SDS is metadata, not pixels.
No execution edge, holder identity, Dataflow pin identity, Camera DMM contract, source descriptor or end-to-end lifetime was recovered.
No unitType check in one BeginExecCommand is insufficient to prove Camera compatibility.
A Camera holder implementing the required selectors, pins and SDF input contract could feed the operation, but no positive static evidence establishes it.

safety: SilentShutter is not declared functional. No original binary was modified, no Ghidra project was deleted, and no camera was connected or flashed.
